intro.title: 1. Introduction
intro.text: This privacy policy describes how MSK Paste processes your data. We follow a privacy-first approach: only the data strictly required for the service is collected.

data.title: 3. Data we process
data.text:
When you create a paste, the following data is stored:
• the content you entered
• an optional title
• the selected programming language
• an optional bcrypt hash of your password
• expiration date and the "burn after read" flag
• an automatically generated delete token
• the paste size in bytes
• the creation timestamp
• an HMAC-SHA-256 hash of your IP address for rate limiting (GDPR compliant)

The original IP address is never stored and cannot be reconstructed from the hash.

cookies.title: 4. Cookies
cookies.text: We set exactly one cookie: NEXT_LOCALE stores your language preference (DE/EN) for 12 months. It is technically necessary and not used for advertising or analytics.

tracking.title: 5. No tracking
tracking.text: No analytics tools (Google Analytics, Plausible, Matomo, …) are used. No GeoIP resolution happens. No third-party scripts are loaded.

retention.title: 6. Retention
retention.text:
Pastes are automatically and permanently deleted after their chosen expiration window. "Burn after read" pastes are wiped immediately after the first successful view. You can delete a paste at any time using its delete token.

IP hashes used for rate limiting are kept only briefly in memory and are automatically discarded after one hour.

rights.title: 7. Your rights
rights.text:
Under the GDPR you have the right to information, rectification, deletion, restriction of processing, data portability, and objection. To exercise these rights, please contact the controller by email.

Because we store no accounts, identification beyond the data stored with the specific paste is not possible.

security.title: 8. Security
security.text: Passwords are stored as bcrypt hashes (cost factor 12) only. All connections are encrypted via HTTPS. The server runs with current security updates and a firewall in place.

thirdParty.title: 9. Third parties
thirdParty.text: Web fonts (Syne, DM Sans, JetBrains Mono) are loaded from Google Fonts. Your IP address is transmitted to Google for this purpose. No cookies are set.

contact.title: 10. Contact
contact.text: For privacy-related questions please email: moritz.kohm@gmail.com
